First report: fishing launches scattered adrift after a squall in Sector Salt Key, estimated at 6 boats. Conditions: afternoon trade-wind chop limiting small boats; fuel drums held at the cay dock until the squall passes. Reports pass over the HF courier net opening only on scheduled windows, with a relay delay of 8 ticks; the decision deadline is tick 50. properties.bodyExcerpt: Authored synthetic example, not a recorded game, engine replay or assessment of a real person. First report: a bulk carrier reporting a steering fault in Sector Falcon Shoal. Conditions: dust haze cutting visual range; a spare-parts launch held for a port clearance window. Reports pass over the port VHF working channel saturated with queue traffic, with a relay delay of 9 ticks; the decision deadline is tick 58. Haze grounds the drone, shamal seas slow the boats, and the single lighter berth sets refuel timing. Outcome (mixed): The low-confidence move toward Sector Falcon Shoal was turned back at the planned point and redirected to Sector Dune Point. Reasoning (supported): Confidence ranges widened on conflict and narrowed on independent corroboration, with the reason recorded each time. A single case cannot show calibration; compare across cases. Same lesson and deadline tick offset as the paired case. Here the relay delay was 9 ticks, so the correction arrived only after the deadline.
